items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Rick Henderson was an old roommate in the Basie – in the Ellington band.

ctx.x: Rick Henderson was an old roommate in the Basie – in the Ellington band. Rick was at one time the leader of the Howard Theater band in Washington, D.C., on 7th and T [Streets, NW] – 7th and Wiltberger [Street, NW].
Do you have – speaking of Washington, do you have any particular recollections of Washington, D.C.?
